mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in economic demand (GDPC1) lowers discount rates applied to equity cash flows, compressing the cost of capital and driving up S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 shows no sustained growth or declines, or 20-day forward returns do not outperform baseline in the absence of other signals.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE remains above 6% or 20-day returns do not rise significantly when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: Dual signals of monetary easing (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) and robust demand growth (GDPC1 > 13,500) create a convergence of expansionary pressures, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If either FEDFUNDS fails to stay below 0.2% or GDPC1 does not exceed 13,500, or returns do not follow when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained drop in UNRATE below 7% strengthens labor market confidence, driving up equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the regime is not late-cycle expansion, or UNRATE does not drop below 7%, or returns do not follow when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 1.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing future equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not exceed 1.5%, or returns do not turn negative when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly growth in the supply index (INDPRO) above 96.82 (current value) reduces inflationary pressures and boosts market optimism, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO contracts or remains flat, or returns do not follow when supply expands.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in UNRATE below 7% and rise in demand (HOUST > 750 units) signals labor market improvement coupled with robust economic activity, amplifying investor sentiment and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If either UNRATE fails to drop below 7% or HOUST does not exceed 750, or returns do not follow when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 2% intensifies discount rate hikes, reducing the present value of equity cash flows and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not exceed 2%, or the regime is not tightening, or returns do not turn negative when the trigger occurs.
